KELAS KENDERAAN

Kelas 1: Kenderaan yang mempunyai dua gandar dan tiga atau empat roda (tidak

termasuk teksi dan bas)

Kelas 2: Kenderaan yang mempunyai dua gandar dan lima atau enam roda (tidak

termasuk bas)

Kelas 3: Kenderaan yang mempunyai tiga gandar atau lebih (tidak termasuk bas)

Kelas 4: Teksi

Kelas 5: Bas

Bagi maksud mengira bilangan gandar dan roda sesebuah kenderaan, gandar dan roda

mana-mana treler yang ditarik oleh kenderaan itu hendaklah dikira sebahagian

daripada gandar dan roda kenderaan itu.".

FEDERAL ROADS (PRIVATE MANAGEMENT) ACT 1984

FEDERAL ROADS (PRIVATE MANAGEMENT) (COLLECTION OF TOLLS)

(WEST COAST EXPRESSWAY (TAIPING-BANTING)) (AMENDMENT) ORDER 2020

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 2 of the Federal Roads

(Private Management) Act 1984 [Act 306], the Minister makes the following order:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) This Order may be cited as the Federal Roads (Private Management)

(Collection of Tolls) (West Coast Expressway (Taiping-Banting))

(Amendment) 2020.

 (2) This Order comes into operation on 1 March 2020.

Amendment of paragraph 2

2. The Federal Roads (Private Management) (Collection of Tolls) (West Coast

Expressway (Taiping-Banting)) Order 2020 [P.U. (A) 14/2020], which is referred to as

the "principal Order" in this Order, is amended in paragraph 2—

(a) in subparagraph (1):

(i) by substituting for the words "column (2)" wherever appearing

the words "column (3)";

(ii) by inserting after the words "column (1)" the words "according

to the period specified in column (2)";

(iii) by substituting for subsubparagraphs (a) and (b) the following

subsubparagraphs:

"(a) kilometre 143.99 at coordinates N 421777.709,

E 333667.462 of the Rectified Skew Orthomorphic

(RSO) Geocentric (GDM 2000) Grid and ending at

kilometre 162.07 at coordinates N 438818.638,

E 331585.659 of the RSO Geocentric (GDM 2000) Grid

including the Hutan Melintang Interchange,

Hutan Melintang Entry/Exit Toll Plaza, Teluk Intan

Entry/Exit Toll Plaza, Teluk Intan Interchange and its

link roads;

(b) kilometre 193.59 at coordinates N 455672.836,

E 310764.161 of the RSO Geocentric (GDM 2000) Grid

and ending at kilometre 241.63 at coordinates

N 498349.253, E 311975.628 of the RSO Geocentric

(GDM 2000) Grid including the Kg. Lekir Interchange,

Kg. Lekir Entry/Exit Toll Plaza, Sitiawan Interchange,

Sitiawan Entry/Exit Toll Plaza, Sitiawan North

Interchange, Sitiawan North Entry/Exit Toll Plaza,

Changkat Chermin Interchange, Changkat Chermin

Entry/Exit Toll Plaza, Beruas Interchange, Beruas

Entry/Exit Toll Plaza and its link roads; and"; and

(iv) by inserting after subsubparagraph (b) the following

subsubparagraph:

"(c) kilometre 32.00 at coordinates N 340831.624,

E 383801.030 of the RSO Geocentric (GDM 2000) Grid

and ending at kilometre 40.07 at coordinates

N 346395.404, E 378602.603 of the RSO Geocentric

(GDM 2000) Grid including the NNKSB Interchange,

Bandar Bukit Raja South Interchange, Bandar Bukit

Raja South Entry/Exit Toll Plaza, Bandar Bukit Raja

North Interchange, Bandar Bukit Raja North Entry/

Exit Toll Plaza and its link roads,"; and

(b) in subparagraph (2), by substituting for the words "the map" the words

"Map A, Map B and Map C".

Amendment of paragraph 3

3. The principal Order is amended in the national language text, by substituting

for subsubparagraph 3(3)(b) the following subsubparagraph:

"(b) berhubung dengan sesuatu kad prabayar, suatu kad prabayar yang

boleh dibaca oleh mesin pembaca yang dipasang di lorong tol; dan".

CLASS OF VEHICLES

Class 1: Vehicles having two axles and three or four wheels (excluding taxis and

buses)

Class 2: Vehicles having two axles and five or six wheels (excluding buses)

Class 3: Vehicles having three axles or more (excluding buses)

Class 4: Taxis

Class 5: Buses

For the purpose of calculating the number of axles and wheels of a vehicle, the axles

and wheels of any trailer towed by the vehicle shall be calculated as part of the axles

and wheels of the vehicles.".
